definitions.first_downs: nflverse first_down (rushing, passing and penalty first downs)
definitions.half_sacks: the game counts sacks in halves (total sacks = 0.5 x this): a full sack is 2, a shared sack 1
definitions.pass_yds: players: gross passing yards; team: net (gross minus yards lost to sacks), the official team figure
definitions.penalties: accepted penalties (declined and offsetting fouls excluded)
definitions.rush_att: includes kneel-downs, as official rushing totals do
definitions.tackles: solo + assisted tackles credited on the play rows (nflverse); not available for PFR games
definitions.time_of_possession: seconds; game-clock time between consecutive nflverse plays credited to the team with the ball on the earlier play (not available for PFR games, whose old play clocks are spaced evenly rather than recorded)
